stem: Two particles A and B start from rest and move for equal time on a straight line. The particle A has an acceleration of ‘a’ for the first half of the time and ‘2a’ for the second half. The particle B has an acceleration of ‘2a’ for the first half and ‘a’ for the second half. What will be the ratio of the distances travelled by A and B?

assets.alt: Velocity–time graph of two cars over time T. B accelerates at 2a then a; A at a then 2a, switching at T/2. Both reach the same final v; the shaded gap between the lines shows the extra distance covered by B.
